node.title: Re: foreach a writing open fails through not found file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hello and welcome to the Monastery, [DomX]!

Note you aren't checking the open for errors; you've commented out the or return(0). So most likely, there's an error when [doc://open]ing the file that you're not seeing, which results in the "print() on closed filehandle" warning. Just yesterday, [id://11101709|I posted] several variants of non-fatal [doc://open] error handling, here's one more I'll add to that post, for use in loops like these:

FILE: for my $file (@files) { open my $fh, ... or do { warn "skipping $file: $!"; next FILE }; ... close $fh; }
